Write any EXCLURAD input files you produce next to it. If the request is physically impossible, refuse and say why. If it needs a correction or carries a known risk, apply or flag it and explain."
I’ll validate the 25 eta kinematic points against the configured table and beam constraints, then generate EXCLURAD’s required chunked input files in the working directory.

The requested endpoints and count imply a 14.375-degree increment: 25 inclusive points from 0 through 345. I will preserve the stated 25-point count and endpoint, validate that grid, then generate the required 10-point EXCLURAD chunks and outcome record.
